Package com.kerosene.kfe.audit.domain

Record Class KfeAuditEvent

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.kerosene.kfe.audit.domain.KfeAuditEvent
Record Components:
eventId - unique identifier for this audit record
eventType - stable event category consumed by audit/search systems
transactionId - related KFE transaction, when applicable
walletId - related wallet, when applicable
principalId - sanitized actor/principal identifier, when available
previousStatus - prior state for transitions or a diagnostic classification
newStatus - resulting state for transitions
amountSats - relevant financial amount in satoshis
feeSats - relevant fee in satoshis
network - blockchain/network label
rail - payment rail label
referenceHash - one-way hash of a txid/payment hash; never the original reference
requestId - request identifier for tracing
correlationId - cross-service correlation identifier
occurredAt - event occurrence time
public record KfeAuditEvent(UUID eventId, String eventType, UUID transactionId, UUID walletId, String principalId, String previousStatus, String newStatus, long amountSats, long feeSats, String network, String rail, String referenceHash, String requestId, String correlationId, Instant occurredAt) extends Record
Immutable audit event for structured JSON logging to the "kerosene.audit.financial" stream.

NEVER log: bearer token, macaroon, full invoice, preimage, PSBT, raw transaction, PII. referenceHash carries a txid or payment_hash hash, never raw values.
